text:
maria: Heads-up — provisioning is failing in us-west3. Several GPU allocs stuck in 'allocating' because local scratch refs are still held after pods exit. NVMe write_latency spiked to ~220ms and wear counters ticked up.
raj: node id? any pattern across racks?
lee: it's gnode-uw3-127 and one other (uw3-131). both show leftover loop devices tied to deleted container images. I killed two loopdevs and freed 1 GPU slot.
sophie: logs: containerd didn't unmount overlay in a few crashes. `losetup -a` shows /dev/loop12 -> /var/lib/containers/.../deleted.img (stale). dmesg also has: "nvme0: I/O 0x3f failed, status: 0x2" and SMART: write_amp jump.
maria: this looks different from the janitor scrub leaks — those were high-level cleaner jobs. these are kernel-held refs from overlayfs/lowerdir that keep the block device pinned.
raj: can we get quick commands to triage so oncall can run?
lee: triage steps I used: `ps -eo pid,stat,cmd | egrep "D|zombie"` to find D-state procs, `lsof +D /var/lib/containers/storage/overlay | grep scratch` to see open handles, then `losetup -a` and `umount /scratch/mntX`. killed zombie (SIGKILL) -> `losetup -d /dev/loop12` -> freed device.
sophie: capturing a small snippet for runbook: ```# check stuck refs
losetup -a
lsof +D /var/lib/containers/storage/overlay | head
ps -o pid,stat,cmd -p <suspect_pid>
# if process in D and safe to reap: kill -9 <pid>
umount /scratch/mntX
losetup -d /dev/loopN
```
maria: we should avoid manual drift — propose adding a node-daemon that detects overlay handles referencing deleted images and tries a graceful unmount/unlink after a quiesce window. also add a quick failure metric so alloc backend can short-circuit retry instead of backoff.
raj: opened INFRA-4521 with remediation + runbook + cost calc. note: this morning's stucks caused ~3m backoff per allocation across 50 allocations -> ~150 GPU-minutes lost. adding that to ticket.
lee: rolling a canary daemon to detect D-state holders and attempt unmount after 10m; will log and alert before forcing. canary target: 3 nodes in uw3 rack B.
sophie: we should also adjust health alert: trigger if write_latency > 200ms AND >3 loop devices referencing deleted images on same node for 5m. avoids noisy alerts.
maria: tagging @oncall for 2h watch — please ack if you see repeats. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: scheduled canary rollout to 3 nodes in us-west3 (gnode-uw3-127, gnode-uw3-131, gnode-uw3-139) at 03:15 UTC.
